# Contributing

## AI-Generated Contributions

Commits authored by `Claude <claude@english-reading.app>` are AI-assisted.

**Rule:** All PRs containing AI-authored commits must be labeled `ai-generated`.

To identify AI commits:
```bash
git log --author="claude@english-reading.app"
```

## Labels

| Label | Usage |
|-------|-------|
| `ai-generated` | PR contains commits by Claude |
